$comment: Which open question Hand back answers. Read by tests/agents-computer-handback.test.ts (src/lib/agents/computer-handback.ts) and by native/Packages/JunoNativeKit/Tests/JunoWorkKitTests/NativeAgentComputerHandBackTests.swift (NativeComputerHandBack), so the web and the apps answer the same question, or none. openAtTakeControl null means control was not taken through Take control (no pin).
answer: Done. I've finished on your computer; continue.

SIGN_IN.question: Could you take over my computer and sign in to the bank?
SIGN_IN.why: The site wants a password only you should type.

CAPTCHA.question: There's a CAPTCHA on my screen. Can you solve it on my computer?

TWO_FACTOR.question: Please take control for the 2FA step.

ENTER_CODE.question: Can you enter the code?
ENTER_CODE.why: Take over and hand it back when you're done.

FOLDER.question: Which folder should I save the report in?

PASSWORD_ACCOUNT.question: Which account should I sign in with, work or personal?

PASSWORD_MENTION.question: Should I save the password in your notes?

handBack.name: answers the takeover question pinned at Take control, not the first one
taking control to look around with an unrelated question open answers nothing
two unrelated questions open answers nothing
the pinned question answered elsewhere meanwhile answers nothing
the pinned question gone never falls through to an unrelated one
the pinned question gone never falls through to a later takeover
a takeover question asked while the person had control is the one
with nothing pinned, the single open takeover question is the one
two takeover questions open at Take control answers neither
two takeover questions asked during control answers neither
two takeover questions and nothing pinned answers neither
